/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const origin = 'http://localhost:3000'
async function page(path, status = 200) {
  const response = await fetch(origin + path, { headers: { 'user-agent': 'migration-test-agent' } })
  const body = await response.text()
  assert.equal(response.status, status, "'`${path} status`)
  return body.replaceAll('"'<"'!-- -->'"', '')
}
let body = await page('/')
assert.ok(body.includes('Welcome to My Blog') && body.includes('migration-test-agent') && body.includes('<title>Home - My Blog</title>'))
assert.equal((body.match(/<li>/g) || []).length, 5)
body = await page('/blog')
assert.ok(body.includes('<title>Blog - My Blog</title>') && body.includes('All Blog Posts'))
body = await page('/blog/1')
assert.ok(/<title>["'^<]+ - My Blog<'"\\/title>/.test(body) && body.includes('Comments (5)') && body.includes('property=\"og:title\"'))
body = await page('/blog/11')
assert.ok(body.includes('Comments (5)'))
body = await page('/missing-route', 404)
assert.ok(body.includes('404 - Page Not Found') && body.includes('<title>404 - Page Not Found</title>'))
body = await page('/blog/99999', 404)
assert.ok(body.includes('404 - Page Not Found'))
const list = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts')
assert.deepEqual((await list.json()).map(post => post.id), [1, 2])
let response = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Hello', content: 'World' }) })
assert.equal(response.status, 201)
assert.equal((await response.json()).title, 'Hello')
response = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' })
assert.equal(response.status, 400)
response = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts/42')
assert.equal((await response.json()).id, 42)
response = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts/42', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Updated' }) })
assert.equal((await response.json()).title, 'Updated')
response = await fetch(origin + '/api/posts/42', { method: 'DELETE' })
assert.equal((await response.json()).message, 'Post 42 deleted successfully')
for (const [path, method, allow] of [['/api/posts', 'DELETE', 'GET, POST'], ['/api/posts/42', 'POST', 'GET, PUT, DELETE'], ['/api/posts', 'OPTIONS', 'GET, POST']]) {
  response = await fetch(origin + path, { method })
  assert.equal(response.status, 405)
  assert.equal(response.headers.get('allow'), allow)
}
console.log('Production route and API smoke checks passed')
EOF"
